death.note: Stated as a reign and never recorded. This folder’s own life has him arrested «in the persecution under Diocletian», and its note calls him «a martyr of Diocletian’s persecution» to tell him from `aetherius-of-cherson`. The interval is Diocletian’s reign, 284–305, which is how sixty-five other folders in this corpus hold that marker. No year, because the page gives none.

He is not `aetherius-of-cherson`, the bishop of Cherson kept on 7 March: this Aetherius is a martyr of Diocletian's persecution, and the page gives him no see, no city and no year.
